label: Hesat system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Hesat locus that can restrict bacteriophage infection.
observations: Hesat branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Hesat genes, Hesat proteins, the pUCCL620_156 source gene locus, DefenseFinder article-registry rows, a proposed colicin-D-like translation-blocking mechanism, and other phage-defense systems.
